ipeds.title: College Navigator - Eastern University (enrollment, student-faculty ratio, test scores note)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024 entering class): 3,108 applied, 2,821 admitted (91%), 591 enrolled; this matches IPEDS. The residency table says 'Data not available', so in-state, out-of-state and international applicant and admit counts are not shown (international admit odds are unknown). The test-score tables are empty; College Navigator lists 1 enrolled student (1%) submitting SAT and notes scores are generally not considered except for applicants with a GPA below 2.75. The GPA table has one column (all enrolled students); the bands add up to 101 because of rounding and give the 3.20 average. The admission-factor checkboxes could not be read, so no factors are shown. The 2025-26 Common Data Set was not found (2024-25 is the latest posted).

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set: books and supplies $1,351 (2025-26). First-year tuition for 2025-26 was $39,188, required fees $928, on-campus food and housing $14,038
